verdict.rationale: jo's docs say it works with your "connected context" for messages, schedules, projects and follow-ups. They also reference a wired-up integrations list, connecting accounts before use, overnight reading of what came in, and reading existing decks, so connected personal data does feed its answers. However, the evidence never explicitly names a cloud-drive, user-email or calendar connector; the documented email is jo's own address, and the named integrations are GitHub, Linear and channel catch-up. Missing for 10: explicit documented cloud drive (e.g. Drive/Dropbox) connector, explicit connection of the user's own email inbox and calendar, search-across-sources detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
